scope: The standing Temple Mount / Haram al-Sharif stone enclosure in Jerusalem, with the retained platform, Western and Southern Wall faces, blocked gates, surviving Robinson’s Arch springing and stepped arcades of the upper Rock Square.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The submitted conservation record identifies the asymmetric four stone walls, gates, raised platforms, and central buildings.
The excavation report identifies the southwest corner junction, Robinson’s Arch, and the base courses of the Western Wall.
